toml:
# Lunar reference-station coverage under the PUBLICLY STATED assumptions: the same kind as
# lunar-station-coverage.toml, with every input that a public source states set from it and
# cited by source id; every input no source states is kept from the in-tree default and
# labelled ILLUSTRATIVE. Sources (retrieved 2026-10-12; titles, identifiers and licences in
# docs/LUNAR-REFERENCE-STATION.md):
#   S1  arXiv:2602.08432v3
#   S2  IOAG Cislunar PNT Workshop 2025, "Lunar local Differential PNT and Selenodetic
#       Reference Station" (slides)
#   S3  UNOOSA ICG WG-B, Lunar PNT, June 2024 (LunarPNT_Jun24_01_04.pdf)
#   S4  IOAG Cislunar 2026, "Moonlight Programme Development Status"
#
# HONESTY: MODELLED. Under these stated public assumptions the model gives the figures this
# run reports. Not a statement about the performance of any real system; not affiliated with
# or endorsed by any agency; no TRL or heritage claim. Omitted: terrain and horizon masking at
# the pole, multipath, receiver hardware.
kind = "lunar-station-coverage"

# Constellation: four satellites in an elliptical lunar frozen orbit with a 24 h period
# favouring the south pole (S4 p6, p10, p12; S2 p14). The element set is not public.
n_sats = 4                 # S4 p10/p12; S2 p14
sma_km = 9737.4            # S4 p6 (24 h period); value in-tree
eccentricity = 0.6         # ILLUSTRATIVE (not public)
inc_deg = 57.7             # ILLUSTRATIVE (not public)
argp_deg = 90.0            # ILLUSTRATIVE (not public)
mask_deg = 5.0             # ILLUSTRATIVE

# Station: an example simulation site near the south pole (S2 p19).
station_lat_deg = -89.4765 # S2 p19
station_lon_deg = -138.135 # S2 p19
station_height_m = 0.0     # ILLUSTRATIVE (on the mean lunar sphere)
survey_sigma_m = 0.30      # ILLUSTRATIVE (S1 p4 gives sub-decimetre as the end-state target)

# Error model. SISE 10 m at least 95 % of the time over any 24 h (S4 p8; S2 p14, p21), read
# as a zero-mean Gaussian 1-sigma of 10 / 1.96 m; the orbit/clock split is ILLUSTRATIVE.
sise_sigma_m = 5.10                 # S4 p8 (10 m at 95 %, as 10 / 1.96)
sise_orbit_variance_fraction = 0.5  # ILLUSTRATIVE
noise_m = 0.30             # S2 p14 (high-quality code, at zenith)
latency_s = 1.0            # S2 p15 (1 s transmission period)
quantization_bits = 8      # ILLUSTRATIVE (the message format is not modelled)

# The region: 80 deg S to the pole, about 300 km around the pole (S2 p10; S3 p23).
grid_lat_max_deg = -80.0   # S2 p10; S3 p23
grid_lat_step_deg = 1.0
t_start_s = 0.0
t_span_s = 86400.0
t_step_s = 600.0
n_trials = 200

# Thresholds, stated before the run and never fitted.
accuracy_threshold_m = 1.0
percentile = 95.0
alert_limit_m = 10.0       # ILLUSTRATIVE: no public alert limit exists
residual_sigma_m = 5.0     # ILLUSTRATIVE
p_hmi = 1e-4
seed = 42
